rules: Every required aspect contains one or more explicit claims.
Scene promotion is fail-closed: every claim must be VERIFIED with concrete evidence.
PLAYABLE or REPLAY_VERIFIED never implies scene fidelity.
Framework contracts generalize validation mechanics, never game-specific semantics or PASS evidence.
Demo and retail scenes require independent evidence when their corpora or runtime semantics differ.
Remote desktop streams are execution aids, not fidelity authorities.
Unknown semantics remain HOLD/BLOCKED; do not synthesize behavior to satisfy a test.
